name: modrinth-mcp
description: Search Modrinth and publish Minecraft mods (create projects, upload versions) through the Modrinth API.

modrinth_token.title: Modrinth Personal Access Token
modrinth_token.description: Create one at https://modrinth.com/settings/pats with scopes: Read projects, Read versions, Create versions, Write versions. Required only for write actions (whoami, create/modify).
